question: How much tax does Alice have to pay in 2013?
text: Alice and Bob got married on Feb 3rd, 1992. Alice was a nonresident alien until July 9th, 2014. Bob died September 16th, 2017. Alice's gross income in 2013 was $71414. Bob's income in 2013 was $56404. Alice files separately and takes the standard deduction.
